scientific_question: Does the molecular-weight mass balance for NH3 + HCl -> NH4Cl agree with PubChem's official ammonium chloride molecular weight within 0.05 g/mol?
goal_text: Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/ammonia/property/MolecularWeight/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.MolecularWeight and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_AMMONIA_MW.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/hydrogen%20chloride/property/MolecularWeight/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.MolecularWeight and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_HYDROGEN_CHLORIDE_MW.json. Using the authoritative JSON source https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/ammonium%20chloride/property/MolecularWeight/JSON, extract JSON path PropertyTable.Properties.0.MolecularWeight and save the knowledge evidence to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PARENT_CHEMISTRY_AMMONIUM_CHLORIDE_MW.json. Calculate the predicted ammonium chloride molecular weight using predicted_product_mw = ammonia_mw + hydrogen_chloride_mw. Determine whether the predicted and official molecular weight scalars differ by at most 0.05.

required_result.producer_result: The final bounded numeric relation artifact emitted by the compiled controller plan.

independent_oracle.method: Re-fetch all three exact PubChem URLs outside the Brain producer, independently parse MolecularWeight, compute ammonia + hydrogen chloride molecular weight, recompute absolute difference and <=0.05 predicate, and compare every consequential relation field.
